title: Isolation of Olfactory Neurons by FACS for 10x Genomics scRNA-seq
author: Daniel Barnes

steps.title: Prepare Fish and Embryos
steps.instruction: Set up fish with GFP/RFP markers and WT fish for negative controls. For OMP:RFP OSN isolation, approximately 1200 embryos are required.

substeps.instruction: Mate fish at 8:00 AM for 30 minutes.
Collect embryos using fresh E3 in new petri dishes.
Bleach embryos and maintain them in sterile E3 (with 1% pen/strep) using new plates.
Use prewarmed media to prevent developmental delays.
Stage embryos if needed.
Optional: Screen out non-fluorescent fish from crosses.
Optional: Use pronase to dechorionate embryos.
Prepare injection setup: ice buckets, tricaine, 67% HBSS, dissection dishes, sample collection tubes, and dissection equipment (e.g., 23g needles or scalpels).

steps.title: Dissect Olfactory Tissue
steps.instruction: Anesthetize and dissect embryos to collect olfactory tissue or whole heads.

substeps.instruction: At 8:00 AM, treat fish with tricaine and place dishes on ice.
Transfer a small number of embryos to a 35mm tissue culture dish lid containing ice-cold 67% HBSS w Ca and Mg; add a few drops of tricaine to maintain anesthesia.
Use a sterile 23G needle to hold the embryo and another to dissect olfactory tissue or the whole head.
Transfer tissue to a sterile-RNAse-free eppendorf tube using a P200 pipette with a filter tip.
Collect tissue from up to 50 embryos per tube (max 30 heads per tube for 72hpf and older), keeping tubes on ice.
Collect tissue from ~200 embryos across 4 eppendorf tubes.
Dissect 20-50 heads from WT embryos for controls.

steps.title: Dissociate Tissue into Single Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Process the collected tissue to release cells using FACSMax and mechanical trituration.

substeps.instruction: Remove as much excess medium as possible from the tubes.
Add 500ul of cold FACSMax to each tube.
Incubate at 28.5°C for 20 minutes in a benchtop heatblock or water bath, inverting the tube every 5 minutes to mix.
Triturate by pipetting up and down 10 times with a 1ml pipette tip.
Incubate for another 10 minutes.
Attach a P200 pipette tip to the 1ml tip and pipette up and down SLOWLY 10 times.
Allow undissociated tissue to settle at the bottom; either pipette these clumps further or remove them.

steps.title: Concentrate and Prepare Cells for FACS
steps.instruction: Pool the suspensions and prepare them for transport to the FACS facility.

substeps.instruction: Combine all fluorescent cell suspensions into one 15ml falcon tube and WT suspensions into another 15ml falcon tube.
Centrifuge both suspensions for 6 minutes at 2000rpm (400g) in a clinical centrifuge.
Remove all medium and replace with 500ul FACS medium for the sample and 100-200ul for the control.
Triturate again: 5X with a 1ml pipette tip and 5X with a P200 tip.
Optional: Filter cell suspensions through a nylon mesh to remove large aggregates.
Transfer suspensions to FACS tubes and transport on ice.
Prepare eppendorf tubes containing 300ul FACS media buffer on ice for cell collection.

steps.title: Perform FACS Sorting
steps.instruction: Sort for OMP:RFP neurons using stringent gating.

substeps.instruction: Use WT samples for background gating (FSC, SSC, and background fluorescence).
Apply stringent gating to capture only the best OMP:RFP neurons, excluding damaged or dying cells.

steps.title: Post-Sort Wash and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Wash the sorted cells to remove HEPES and prepare them for 10x Genomics scRNA-seq.

substeps.instruction: Pellet collected cells by centrifugation at 400g for 6 minutes and remove sorting solution.
Resuspend in 1ml 10x wash media.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 400g for 3 minutes and remove wash media.
Resuspend cells in 10x run Media at a volume determined by the 10x manual efficiency chart based on the number of cells sorted.
